//: The direct-download build's extras, merged over tauri.conf.json by `npm run desktop:build`. They live in their own file for two reasons. Tauri validates externalBin when the crate is compiled, so a sidecar declared in the base configuration would make `cargo check` require a release build of the CLI — and the local gate compiles this crate on every run. And PRD §10.1 splits this product into a direct build that carries the injection engine and a Mac App Store build that cannot, so the direct build's extras belonging to the direct build is the shape that split will need; P02 owns the store variant.
